# coolify_notification_webhook (Resource)

Manages the current team's Webhook notification settings in Coolify. This is a team-scoped singleton (one configuration per team, selected by the API token). Requires Coolify >= v4.3.0.

On destroy, Webhook notifications are disabled (`enabled = false`); the webhook URL is left unchanged. Import with id `current`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Team generic webhook notification settings (Coolify >= v4.3.0).
# Import: terraform import coolify_notification_webhook.main current
resource "coolify_notification_webhook" "main" {
  enabled     = true
  webhook_url = "https://example.com/coolify-webhook"

  deployment_failure = true
  backup_failure     = true
  server_disk_usage  = true
  server_unreachable = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `backup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for backup failure events.
- `backup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for backup success events.
- `deployment_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for deployment failure events.
- `deployment_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for deployment success events.
- `docker_cleanup_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for Docker cleanup failure events.
- `docker_cleanup_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for Docker cleanup success events.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Webhook notifications are enabled for the team.
- `scheduled_task_failure` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for scheduled task failure events.
- `scheduled_task_success` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for scheduled task success events.
- `server_disk_usage` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for server disk usage events.
- `server_patch` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for server patch events.
- `server_reachable` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for server reachable events.
- `server_unreachable` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for server unreachable events.
- `status_change` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for status change events.
- `traefik_outdated` (Boolean) Whether to send Webhook notifications for Traefik outdated events.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Generic webhook URL. Sensitive; Coolify may omit it on read unless the API token can read sensitive fields (`read:sensitive` or root). Preserve the value in configuration after import. Must pass Coolify's SafeWebhookUrl rule (public http/https; private/loopback hosts rejected).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Always `current` (team is implied by the API token).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import coolify_notification_webhook.main current
```
